method: Historical mechanical coho replay using Oswego River at Lock 7, Oswego, NY USGS 04249000 daily mean discharge, no measured-temperature score; the configured temperature weight is zero because no multi-season daily record passed replay, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to Hydraulic-only read for the short lower corridor. Temperature has zero influence. Canal exclusion, power operations, and Lake Ontario backwater sharply limit interpretation. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
